avis.texte: I have purchased both the regular and the pink lemonade version of this product, and while both work great to get that "gritty" textured feeling off my face, I'm disappointed to say that the strawberry lemonade version smells off. It's almost as if the tube is old or expired. I have not had an adverse reaction yet, but it may be on sale because of old stock.
It's a great scrub, exfoliates well. The only con is that the tube comes half empty.

I love using this exfoliating scrub! Ive tried other brands (PTR & Dermologica) but the exfoliating particles always felt too small. With the OLEHENRIKSEN scrub the particles are a little larger and I can actually feel the smoothness after! I have maturing 39 yr old skin, with an oily T zone & very dry outer perimeter, with sun spots, and acne. I let the scrub sit for a few minutes while I'm in the shower and will do that every 4 or more days. My skin is brighter, smoother, and it helps my makeup application look flawless as well!

avis.titre: Love this, on my fourth tube...
avis.texte: I've been using this scrub for a couple years now, probably about once a week since I have pretty sensitive skin and any more would cause problems. I have dry, sensitive skin so once I find something that works and doesn't cause damage to my skin - or hurt - I try to stick with it. I don't really have a problem with pores other than some in the crease between my bottom lip and chin, but this does amazing for my dry skin. I only use it in the summer when the heat isn't on constantly and drying out my skin and making it more sensitive (as opposed to winter), so I go through about a tube per summer (late spring and early fall).

My only gripe is that the scent isn't sweeter...it's a bit off. But the product itself works wonderfully. Leave it on for a few minutes to get the chemical exfoliation effect after scrubbing for the physical cleansing. Rinses to perfect skin!

avis.titre: I will definitely be buying this again!
avis.texte: I have used many scrubs and this is my all time favorite! It smells great and the scrub is really fine so it spreads nicely on the skin. I scrub it around with my fingertips after I cleanse my face in the shower. Then after about 30 seconds of massaging it into my face I just leave it on while I take my shower. Then rinse at the end. It makes my face so smooth I love it!
I like to leave it on for a couple minutes in the shower and it leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. Love the smell! Helped clear my bacne.

avis.titre: I Received This Item in BoxyCharm Box
avis.texte: I tried it for about a week, as soon as I added it to my skincare routine I noticed little pimples forming and soon it got worse. I don't recommend.
this was okay, I felt like it ever really rinsed clean off my skin. I wouldn't buy it again.

I'm pleasantly surprised with this. It didn't dry out my skin more than it already was, nor did it irritate my sensitive skin. My skin is in perimenopause mode and going through h*ll because of some medication I'm on. I've been looking for some gentle exfoliant to use daily to help clear my pore and clear my face. After using this for a week, I think this is the ticket. I use this daily, at night, after I use a gentle cleanser, and then always moisturize. The smell isn't strawberry and lemon though. It smells like marinara sauce. lol. Luckily it's a short lived smell and when you rinse it off, the smell is gone.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: Love love love this product! Super strong exfoliant so definitely avoid using under your eyes. You really only need a pea size amount for your face too. So much improvement in my skin in terms of texture, bumps, and scarring.
I have the driest skin on the planet and i use this everyday. Noticeable change in texture and wrinkles. And my skin is so soft now. Search no more.

This product made my entire face break out. I have been using the same cleanser and toner for a decade and this scrub was the only new product in my lineup. After two weeks of usage, it destroyed my skin and made me break out in more than 100 breakouts. Yes I counted. I cannot believe this product did this to my skin. I think it's too late for a refund, but please save yourself and your skin.

This product single-handedly destroyed my skin after a few weeks of usage. Ive been using the same cleanser and toner for 8 years, this scrub isthe only NEW product I used on my face, and I completely broke out my entire forehead and cheeks and chin. I think it's too late to get a refund, but I just want to save you your skin. Do not buy this product.
I have some what of sensitive skin, I sampled this product before purchasing it. I tried it once and woke up with bumps all over my face.
Love the fresh scent of lemon. Honstly, will not invest in another one. I bought it twice thinking it was my skin going through some changes. But unfortunately its the product.

I love using an exfoliator a couple times a week and have tried several. Some are too harsh while others aren't strong enough. This is the perfect intensity. Skin looks brighter after use and I love the lemon scent.

This is a poor replacement for the far superior walnut scrub that was discontinued as this was being rolled out. The product dissolves which is useful for cleanup, but I don't feel that I have time to get as deep and thorough an exfoliation as I did with this product's predecessor before this stuff totally dissolves. Its not a bad product, its just not a suitable replacement. Im disappointed.

Love that this is not too intense, smells great, and washes off well. You absolutley can get something similar at drugstore prices but this was a nice treat. Aveeno makes a good alternative at a lower price.
While it is more on the expensive side, man does it work. Gave an evenness to my skin and i really only need to use it twice a week, the results carry over a couple days. Also, smells lovely.

They really discontinued an amazing product (the walnut face scrub) in favor of this one which does not work as well. Id have to use half a bottle of this scrub to get the same exfoliation a teaspoon of the walnut scrub would have achieved, and I wouldn't be putting any sugar on my face.

Love this exfoliator. I left in the shower and my husband loves it as well. Only con, as with all the Ole products, its SMALL. Youre getting .3 ounces…..def take advantage of the sales and coupons. I wouldnt pay full price.
I love this scrub. Luxurious and refreshing. The full size seems small for the retail price, though.
This is my first time trying this product and I am really happy with it. The fragrance is heavenly. Like walking in a lemon grove, with morning dew. It leaves my fact feeling so clean and fresh.
I seriously look forward to using this every time! Makes my skin feel amazing. I will be buying it over and over!
This is my holy grail scrub! I love the texture and it smells wonderful !
Awesomf scrub not too harsh. I keep it in the shower and my husband started using it and loves it too!

My new favorite exfoliator. Does an excellent job at removing dead skin leaving my face feeling soft and smooth and ready for masks or serums and i can definetly tell they absorb better after using this. I also use it on my chest if i have a breakout and it clears it up fast! Im not even out of my first bottle and ive already respurchased another. I think ive found an i cant live without product with this stuff! Ive even been getting compliments on my skin and i think this product is a big part to do with that. I try to use it every third day
Love it my skin is a flex and this product is fantastic leaves skin face super cleansed love it

avis.titre: For the face, no. Body, yes!
avis.texte: I do not use this for my face. I use this as a body exfoliant and this is by far the best one I have used. Evened out my skin tone, helped with keratosis pilaris, completely eliminated bikini line ingrown hairs, flawless fake tan application. It's so good for the body. I do not recommend using this on your face as it is a chemical and manual exfoliant in one. The manual exfoliant doesn't immediately fall apart and you really only need a small amount due to the concentration of the chemical exfoliant. For self tanning, I would use this the day before or several hours before I planned to tan.
This facial scrub is nice and refreshing and a slight lemony scent, it scrubbed my face nicely, but I like a bit heavier exfoliant.

Bought the mini size to try it out and I'm so glad I did!!! I had to go buy the full size! This product leaves my skin so soft after every use. My dark spots have noticeably minimized. I totally recommend this product!
Best face scrub i have ever used. Its gritty enough to exfoliate but not too hard or too gentle that it doesnt do anything. You only need to use a small amount
I have extremely sensitive acne prone skin and this product has not broken me out at all! My skin is literally the clearest its been in years and glowing!
I love that its properties don't dissolve after you start rubbing it around. It does a superior job cleaning pores and exfoliating. I've used dozens of exfoliants and this is by far my favorite.

The product is amazing, it's both a manual and chemical exfoliater. It leaves your skin refreshed, brightened and even a little more firm in just 1-2 uses. Its very similar to exfolikate but much better price. I'd buy the regular size since it doesnt seem to have much product in the mini. 10/10 scrub!! Must have.
Literally my favorite scrub. I'm so glad it's now on here because it has been a hassle to ship it in the past. I've been using this product the past two years.

I love the smell of the scrub, amazing fresh lemon smell that leaves my face squeaky, clean after a satisfying scrub. Not harsh at all, but effective enough to leave you glowing and shining, love this product.

This is a great product! I use it once a week and really focus on circular motions while rubbing it into my skin. I take my time letting it emulsify and break down on my skin and message my face in a warm steamy shower. I know this is meant for night but I tend to use it in the morning when I do exfoliating. Amazing product for the cost and quantity! Plus the scent can' be beat
I don't know that its better than any other pumiced scrub but I like it alot.
I got this as a free gift with my purchase. I used this to exfoliate and first of all, it smells so good and it really made my skin so soft and glowy! Would definitely purchase.
I think this helps to keep the complexion clear. No breakouts, no dark spots, i love the lemony scent and above all, the results.
Leaves my skin feeling so smooth & clean and I love the smell
The best scrub I ever use to my face The most amazing skincare line.. I love all their products
Looove this product. Leaves my face feeling so fresh, and it smells great. A little bit goes a long way, would highly recommend if you're looking for a good exfoliant.

I absolutely love this product. I have avoided mechanical exfoliation because it can cause microtears that eventually exacerbate acne, but that has left my skin's surface visibly textured. After one use of this, my skin felt softer, looked smoother, and was glowy (my friends commented on it at breakfast). Legitimately incredible product and I'm excited to purchase it and keep using it in the future.
We love this scrub. It cleans and smooth your skin real good and it smells amazing!

avis.titre: The GLOW after i use this
avis.texte: This is so good. It makes my skin glow after i use it. It exfoliates my skin and makes my skin look great. Highly recommend. My skin is super soft and glowy after using this which i love. If u have sensitive skin it might be a little much but try it to see.
The smell isn't as bad as most of the other products I purchased, and the scrub definitely removes the gunk.

avis.titre: Love it for me and my daughters!
avis.texte: I love how my skin glows after using. My daughters love using it once a week to maintain their skin clean and glowy.
Very effective exfoliating scrub with a pleasant relaxing scent

I really enjoy this scrub. It gently exfoliates my skin without being overly harsh. I wouldn' leave it on my skin past two mins or else my skin gets a little too red. However I would definitely recommend this scrub!
Nice, gentle, exfoliating scrub with a wonderful lemony scent. It's my go to scrub!
This stuff is amazing. Makes my skin feel like a baby's bottom and my pores much smaller!
Great for people with Oily skin. Noticed lightning of my dark spots after a couple of weeks.

This is an amazing product! Not only do I love it for exfoliating my face, but my son has KP on his arms and with using this it has almost completely cleared up without irritating his sensitive skin! Definitely a keeper!
It' smells amazing, just like lemonade. It is a physical exfoliant but it is not very harsh. My skin never felt irritated while using this.
Disappointed miss the walnut scrub. I was hoping this would be a good alternative
It's good. Not great, but no reason to give it less than 3 stars. Does what says and smells good. Not too harsh either.
LOVE! It's like getting your face professionally exfoliated with dermabrasion! I use it every morning followed by the Glow2OH Dark Spot Toner. My skin is instantly brighter. Truly AMAZING!
Refreshing scrub. Bright scent and light exfoliating scrub feels great and offers results.
I have sensitive skin, and this product is not at all irritating. It has a mild, lovely fragrance and leaves skin fragrant.

avis.titre: No substitute for the walnut scrub
avis.texte: The first time I used this scrub it stung my face. I quickly rinsed it off. The second time I used it, it stung less but absolutely stripped my face of all moisture yet somehow managed not to help with the little bit of flakiness on my chin, which I think any halfway decent scrub would easily handle. I used it one more time and the experience did not improve. Please bring back the walnut scrub or something comparable. This is most definitely not it.
Love this scrub. It's perfect for a weekly exfoliation treatment. It has a fresh scent and leaves the skin feeling smooth.

Love this! Leaves my skin feeling great and clean, not oily or dry at all. I've had so reaction nor does my skin feel different after using. It's a average exfoliating scrub too, not too harsh at all.
I love OH products, but for me this face scrub isn' too special.
Great scrub, bought because my favorite, Ole walnut scrub, wasn't available. Did the trick.
I use this especially on nights when I've worn make up all day. It is really good and my skin feels very clean and smooth aftewards.
This smelled very good. Lemon and citrus! It performed well exfoliating my face not good for sensitive skin. That is why I took off a star. Other than that, works well!
Does an amazing job in cleaning my skin from everything you don' want on it.
Clean fresh scent,wonderful tiny grained scrub. My skin feels so clean.
The Lemonade Smoothing Scrub has been the best I've purchased to-date.
Feels nice and smells good too. Leaves my skin feeling clean & soft. I switch between this & the sugar scrub.
this is an amazing product that takes care of texture and acne it is so gentle that i can use it everyday and every other day. the scent is not too strong either

I never really used scrubs since my skin is very sensitive. I gave this one a try thanks to my friend that recommended it. It's not too harsh and my skin took it well. After washing my face, it was so soft.

This was a product I was excited for.. trust me it works as an exfoliating scrub and fits in with my routine. The reason for a 3/5 is that it doesn' smell like lemons more sweeter than citrus. I'm still using it and I'm not saying it's a terrible smell or disgusting. It's just not as citrusy as I was expecting. I will purchase another as I use this 1-2 times per week to get my dead skin off.

My skin feels amazing, my pores are even smaller. I find myself being less oily throughout the day as well. My skin is looking better than it has for a while overall. My 16 year old daughter is also obsessed.
I love this product!! I figured out that you use it after your face wash and leave it on for about 1-2 min. It works so well and really helps my face get all the dead cells off. I recommend!
I really like this product! Great for sloughing off dead skin! Gentle enough to use everyday! Highly recommend !
Recently bought this scrub and absolutely love it! I have super sensitive skin so I was a little hesitant on buying, but I absolutely love it and how it makes my skin look and feel!

avis.titre: A fresh start with Lemonade Smoothing Scrub
avis.texte: If you are looking for an exfoliating scrub, I would highly recommend the Lemonade Smoothing Scrub. It just makes your face feel clean and like you are starting fresh.

I keep this in the shower it's the perfect addition to your morning routine. It's gentle enough for face but I've used it on my chest back and elbows too. g @olehenriksen #YourMainSqueeze #complimentary

I love the smell. So fresh and like an actual lemon. It's the perfect texture. It's gentle enough to use on my face and strong enough to use on rough elbows. I did receive as a sample review product but that doesn' mean I wouldn' trash it if it didn' work well. I will always be honest ha. I keep this in the shower at all times. Perfect for morning shower
The best scrub I have ever used. Could see a difference in one day. Plus it smells heavenly.

I absolutely love this scrub it is the most softness deep scrub ever. It's so gentle and lifts up dirt you can feel the dirt coming off your skin while scrubbing. I was really surprised definitely met my expectations I definitely recommend it. And it doesn't smell bad. The smell is really satisfying. Go grab yours before I clean out the shelf

First things first I have never gone back to a website solely to leave a review. Secondly, I always thought all of these reviews were fake just to boost product and many times it is. BUT LET ME TELL YOU. I recently changed my entire skincare over to OLE and it has been the wisest change ever. The lemonade scrub is my favorite out of all the stuff I got but everything has been working great. I am 21 and workout frequently and struggle with acne and skin texture quality. Not that I'm fantastic looking to begin with but wow after two weeks of use my skin texture and acne have improved so so much, everything they make is such high quality especially at a reasonable price point. 10/10 recommend to ANYONE

I have a very mixed review on this product for a few different reasons. Starting with the positive, I did like how soft it left my skin after using BUT, having sensitive skin, it did burn while I used it and I thought it would smell better for a facial scrub. Overall, I probably won't use it again because it did really burn my skin. If it was made with gentler ingredients I would consider using it!
I use this 2-3 times per week, and it leave my skin soft and smooth. The scent is divine!
My new favorite face scrub! Smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling refreshed
I usually use the Fresh brand sugar face scrub but tried this and I am glad I did. Works gently and smells great.

I love this product. I'd been having issues with flaky dry skin on my face that I couldn' seem to control, and as soon as I started using this scrub combined with a good moisturizer, my skin looks and feels so much better. So happy with this purchase.
Absolutely amazing!!! Just from one use my skin was softer and pores were smaller. My skin felt soo good! Will definitely be re-buying again.
Use gently, I love anything with lemon but I was expecting a little more lemon smell. All in all I like it.
Nice scrubbing cleanser. Not harsh or during. Exfoliates well.

After using this product, I can say i am hooked. The smell is amazing. It goes on light weight. You can use as wash or leave on for few mins as a mask. I immediately could tell the difference in my skin. So soft. Def recommend this product. #influenster #olehenriksen
Omg I love this definitely works! I love how it works to smooth the skin.
This is a nice scrub. I have pretty sensitive skin so I would definitely follow the directions to only leave it on 2-3 minutes. You can definitely feel it working.

Olehenriksen Lemonade Smoothing Scrub I absolutely live this. The scent is amazing. Almost good enough to eat lol. Feels great on my face and after. It's now part of my daily routine. Highly recommended.
